# 75109 - Dual line driver (75109-75110)

Package DIP-14 · family 751xx · catalogue file [catalog/chips/75109.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/75109.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 43 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![75109 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/75109.png) | ![75109 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-75109.png) | ![75109 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-75109.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | VCC+ | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 11 | VCC- | power |  |  | -5 V |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 1 | 1A | input |  |  |  |
| 2 | 1B | input |  |  |  |
| 5 | 2A | input |  |  |  |
| 6 | 2B | input |  |  |  |
| 3 | 1C | enable | high |  | controls pins 13, 12; when not enabled: float; inhibitor for channel 1: low turns both outputs of channel 1 off |
| 4 | 2C | enable | high |  | controls pins 8, 9; when not enabled: float; inhibitor for channel 2 |
| 10 | D | enable | high |  | controls pins 13, 12, 8, 9; when not enabled: float; inhibitor common to both channels |
| 13 | 1Y | output |  | open-collector | current-switch output (sinks the on-state current when on, off = high impedance); low = on, high = off |
| 12 | 1Z | output |  | open-collector | current-switch output (sinks the on-state current when on, off = high impedance); low = on, high = off |
| 8 | 2Y | output |  | open-collector | current-switch output (sinks the on-state current when on, off = high impedance); low = on, high = off |
| 9 | 2Z | output |  | open-collector | current-switch output (sinks the on-state current when on, off = high impedance); low = on, high = off |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 13,8 | Y on (low) = C AND D AND NOT (A AND B); otherwise off (high) | Truth table: with both inhibitors high, Y is on when A or B is low; when A and B are both high, Y is off and Z is on. |
| 12,9 | Z on (low) = C AND D AND A AND B; otherwise off (high) | Complementary current output of the same channel. Either inhibitor low turns both Y and Z off. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputMaxVoltageV | 10 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | VCC+ 4.75-5.25 V, VCC- -4.75 to -5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. Current-mode outputs: on-state output current SN75109 min 3.5 mA, max 7 mA (SN75110: 6.5 to 15 mA); off-state current max 100 uA. Common-mode output voltage range 0 to +10 V and 0 to -3 V (recommended). Logic and inhibitor inputs VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V. When one channel is unused, inhibit it and/or ground its outputs. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC+ 5 V, VCC- -5 V, TA 25 C, RL 50 ohm, CL 40 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A or B | Y or Z | PLH | 9 | 15 |
| A or B | Y or Z | PHL | 9 | 15 |
| C or D | Y or Z | PLH | 16 | 25 |
| C or D | Y or Z | PHL | 13 | 25 |

## Not known

- IOL/IOH are not meaningful for these current-switch outputs; the datasheet gives on-state current instead (recorded in notes), so both current fields are null.
- No minimum propagation delays printed.

## Notes

ND symbol covers 75109 and 75110; they differ only in on-state current (75109 about 6 mA, 75110 about 12 mA typical per page 4-6).

## Sources

- [TI The Interface Circuits Data Book 2nd ed. 1974, SN55109/SN55110/SN75109/SN75110 (bulletin DL-S 7111224)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1974_TI_The_Interface_Data_Book_for_Design_Engineers_Second_Edition.pdf) - 4-6, 4-16, 4-17 (PDF pages 70, 80, 81); SN75109 (SN75110 figures noted)
